human_approval.detail: 0 of 321 records carry a properly evidenced human approval -- the numerator is 0 because NOTHING HAS BEEN APPROVED: 321 of 321 records carry human_approval_status at its no-claim value and 0 carry the grant value. This is a measured zero, not a constant and not a schema limitation. Counts a record in the numerator only if human_approval_status carries its grant value AND approval_evidence.human_approval carries all six required elements: a named individual (not a role, not a team), their declared role, independence evidence against this record's own owner_role and its current-revision author, an ISO-8601 date, the sha256 of the review packet they signed plus that packet's own recorded record digest, and a revision_history entry recording the approval. Computed by the same predicate the validator enforces, so the figure cannot read higher than the gate permits. Denominator: every record carrying an id.
